claim_ceiling: This benchmark proves only that REAL cached OpenCaseLaw rows carry the fields the query_result_bundle contract needs (decision_id, canonical_url on mcp.opencaselaw.ch, language, citation strings, statutes, a frozen-marker-rule text surface) and that the ACCEPTED harness rejects a regressed bundle. It does NOT prove that Product builds such a bundle, that the map is useful to a jurist, that counter labels are calibrated (counter_uncertainty is a fixed fixture constant), that the coordinates are a good layout (they are a deterministic fixture layout, not a geometry claim), or anything about the absolute LABEL_SOUND / GEOMETRY_SOUND bars. Recall figures are measured, not thresholded.
evidence_summary: Benchmark run 40159747851: BENCHMARK_VALID_NO_FALSIFICATION (exit 0) on 4 frozen query-map questions using real cached OpenCaseLaw envelopes (24 total, all 24 indexed for frozen queries). Leg 1 producer baseline: all 4 questions PASS (222, 218, 221, 206 decisions respectively). Leg 2 falsification: blanked counter evidence correctly breaks counter_classifications_supported on questions with candidate labels (rent-default, petty-theft-dismissal); on questions with zero counter candidates (corporate-criminal-liability, business-judgment-rule) the blanking is a no-op consistent with accepted negative finding. Leg 3 falsification: broken source URLs correctly break source_urls_valid. Counter-authority yield: 2/4 questions have zero candidate-limiting rows under frozen marker_rule (corporate-criminal-liability, business-judgment-rule) — accepted negative result matching frozen hypothesis. Source validity: all rows carry non-empty decision_id and canonical_url on mcp.opencaselaw.ch. Duplicate-free: all bundles pass. Geometry preserved: initial/final signatures match. Fixture mode: True, network_calls: 0 — no live claims. All 76 harness checks hold across initial/final/regressed states. No 174k science invoked; frozen spec SHA256 unchanged before/after. Honest negative result: 2/4 questions yield zero counter candidates under lexical marker rule, reported as finding not defect.
